parameters.name: tsanet_username
parameters.description: TSANet API username (email of your dedicated TSANet API user)

parameters.name: tsanet_password
parameters.description: TSANet API password. Stored as a secure setting. Avoid double-quote and backslash characters in this value (it is inserted server-side into a JSON login body).

parameters.name: field_id_token
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Token. Leave blank on install. Open TSANet Connect from the left nav bar, click "Detect field IDs", then Apply, and the app fills this in from your instance. No hand-copying.

parameters.name: field_id_tokens_multi
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Tokens Multi (optional). Leave blank on install. "Detect field IDs" fills this in if the field exists on your instance, and skips it if it does not.

parameters.name: field_id_status
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Status (dropdown). Leave blank on install. "Detect field IDs" in the app fills this in from your instance.

parameters.name: field_id_partner
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Partner. Leave blank on install. "Detect field IDs" in the app fills this in from your instance.

parameters.name: field_id_respond_by
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Respond By (date). Leave blank on install. "Detect field IDs" in the app fills this in from your instance.

parameters.name: allowed_action_roles
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of Zendesk role names allowed to invoke TSANet actions (e.g. admin or a custom role name). Empty = all agents. Defense-in-depth only; the TSANet API is the real authorization boundary.

parameters.name: field_id_action
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Action (the dropdown that drives Accept/Reject/Info/Note). Optional, part of "Native Field Actions and One-Click Macros". Leave blank on install. "Detect field IDs" fills it in if the field exists, and it must be set together with field_id_action_text: one without the other is rejected, not guessed at.

parameters.name: field_id_action_text
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Action Text (free-text body for Add Note). Optional, and set together with field_id_action or leave both blank. Leave blank on install. "Detect field IDs" fills it in if the field exists.

parameters.name: tsanet_connection_name
parameters.description: Name of the ZIS OAuth connection used for TSANet API calls. Leave as tsanet_oauth unless your instance registered it under a different name.

parameters.name: tsanet_integration_name
parameters.description: Name of the ZIS integration container this instance registered. Leave as tsanet_connect unless Zendesk refused that name for your account, in which case enter the name you registered instead. Lowercase letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, 1-64 characters, per Zendesk's documented rule for ZIS integration names.

parameters.name: tsanet_engineer_email
parameters.description: Email used as engineerEmail on TSANet Accept calls. Must be on your member company's registered domain. Required only if you use field actions; the sidebar app does not need it.

parameters.name: shared_author_user_id
parameters.description: Optional numeric Zendesk user id of a dedicated shared user (e.g. 'IBM via TSANet') to author connector-written comments: inbound descriptions, receipts and mirrored partner notes. Empty = comments show under the connection user, today's behavior. Create the user with an email on YOUR OWN domain, never the partner's. Either an end user (no seat) or a light agent works; comments stay private either way.
